# Markham Heating & Cooling

> From its base in Markham, York Region, Markham Heating & Cooling serves homeowners with residential HVAC work: emergency furnace repair, AC tune-ups and replacements, ductless mini-splits, cold-climate heat pumps, gas fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (905) 472-3610  |  Email: contact@markhamheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://markhamheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Markham, Richmond Hill, Newmarket, Aurora, Vaughan, Keswick, Stouffville, King City
